decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is core business, and its website presence grew in 2024 to a page of its own.
The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the shoe range, though it was only mentioned on the website and could be folded into the broader insole system.
The supportive insole rounds out the insole portfolio cheaply, despite its modest visibility.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has had a page of its own in both years, which signals a strategic, sustained product.
The firefighter and rescue boots serve a specialized niche with certified products, and their visibility increased in 2024.
The moulded FIT insole is featured on the home page and has been used in a reference project with ALBA Braunschweig, making it a flagship offering.
